The early farmers that introduced agricultures, for instance, certainly were a gigantic boon to prehistoric Europe, but farming - and the knowledge necessary to perform it - is not something you find in the genetic code of people. One of the reasons why Europe was so successful in the bigger picture of things was that it a) enjoyed relatively mild climate which allowed for high population density, and b) its various nations spend about as much time bashing each others' skulls in as they did trading with each other, allowing for the flow and exchange of often wildly different ideologies and ideas.

Compare that to China, which used to be one the most magnificent world powers in its heyday but then entered a rather drastic decline and was raped to death with opium because the Chinese believed their country was the center of the universe and they could nothing valuable from other people. Or the jungle Empires of the Aztecs and Mayas, who certainly were remarkable in their own rights, but ultimately entered an age of stagnation and defeat because Mesoamerica did not lend itself to far-reaching trade routes such as the Eurasia's Silk Road.

Modern immigration sadly follows a wildly different pattern in that it chiefly sees people of third and second-world countries swarm first-world ones. Barring the odd actual professor that had to leave the country because his benevolent leaders indeed want his head on a plate, these people have little to contribute to their new societies safe for raw workforce, and that in turn is a resource whose necessity is continually decreasing with the ever-ongoing mechanization of the American and European industrial sector.

Or, to put it into a very blunt metaphor: Immigration is good and helpful when the immigrants come from different cultures that nonetheless have a comparatively similar level of technology and culture (and even better if that of the immigrants exceeds that of the host). Hate-speech in post titles, a few problems and solutions.

  1. Allow users to block (hide, not see) posts which are posted by a particular user. Unfortunately, this solution doesn't help with anonymous posts, and, the blocked user's posts which have non-offensive titles are also hidden.

The above solutions are in alignment with support of Freedom of Speech. The essence of Free Speech is twofold. First, a person must be free to say whatever they choose, to whomever they choose. Second, a person must be free to listen, or not listen, to whomever they choose. In other words, Free Speech implies that people are in control of, and can take responsibility for, their own speaking and listening (reading and writing, watching and publishing).

No AI application or team of censors can effectively manage hate-speech.   • blocking a user will prevent the blocked user from sending you PMs as well as any comment/submission replies and user mentions (pings). They are basically silently dropped (https://voat.co/v/announcements/1325984)

  • Blocked user functionality extends into comment sections. If you block a user, their comments will be collapsed. Please note that currently when you block a user, all notifications and PMs are dropped entirely (https://voat.co/v/announcements/1606918)

  • This feature was also extended to collapsing the comments of a blocked user (but I can't locate the announcement on this one, this is just from memory).

You access the log of your blocked users via subscriptions and then in Menu, hit Blocked Users, or https://voat.co/user/blocked/user. Here you can add and remove blocks on users.

Also, Anonymized Mention Blocks
